More Confidence In Myself. I’m turning 15 soon and am taking my learners permit on the 7th, I was doing tests online at first, but wasn’t learning anything, like, at all. I was super scared, but I realized that this is the exact same stuff that’s on the test, and I’m actually pretty good at this. I have confidence that I’ll pass my learners permit test.

Fantastic app!. Has multiple tests, broken down by category. It has a simple interface and two high value categories for repeat questions - favorites and errors. By tracking mistakes and letting you try again it made learning super simple.

If you’re cramming last minute for your driving test- this app is it.

Many thanks to the developers and designers behind this app.

Great app for new drivers. This app has honestly helped me so much when I’m studying, more than my drivers ed did. I’m giving it four stars because of the ads, but other than that a great app and study buddy!

Passed my Utah permit test first time. I’ve tried various other apps before when I was taking my California permit test at 16/17 but I had failed that twice... Now I’m 21 and using this app and a full day of studying the handbook helped me pass with 90% the first time. I know it’ll vary on the state but the ways questions were worded here wasn’t too different from the Utah test, and as long as you know why the correct answers are correct you’ll understand them as they show up on the permit test. Not every single question is going to be on this app but I recognized a lot of similar ones on the test. If you’re able and have time, use this with the hand book and if you’re doing a last minute cram go through all the questions on this app will help at least a little. Good luck out there!
